articles.title: Trash Can
articles.description: In October 2025 I bought a trash can from the Oak Park Business district on Facebook Market Place for $25. I then placed it in front of my house and have since been maintaining it for the neighborhood. It gets a lot of use and the amount of trash in the area has seamingly decreased.

articles.title: Zoning Visualizer
articles.description: ere is a website I created to help visualize what zoning changes will look like in Sacramento. It is very much a work in progress and I have not worked on it recently. I even started on a much more straight forward redesign with a new focus on creating a way to show people what the new zoning changes in Sacramento will look like in their neighborhood. Though I have not gotten far.
